---
title: "Decision Making in Collectives With Dynamic Individual Memory"
date: 2021-12-01
categories: [collective behavior, modeling]
description: "A model of collective decision-making in dynamic environments."
image: ../images/cdm.png
---

This project revisited Bayesian decision models for animal collectives, especially how individuals use social and non-social information when choosing between options. I studied how dynamic individual memory affects consensus in changing environments and how heterogeneity in sensory information can shift group decisions.
